description_en: Override the Bedrock Mantle endpoint URL. See [Mantle endpoint](/en/amazon-bedrock#use-the-mantle-endpoint)
description_ja: Amazon Bedrock Mantle のエンドポイント URL を上書きします。
doc_snippets: Variable Purpose CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE Enable the Mantle endpoint. Set to 1 or true . ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_MANTLE_BASE_URL Override the default Mantle endpoint URL CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_MANTLE_AUTH Skip client-side authentication for proxy setups ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL_AWS_REGION Override AWS region for the Haiku-class model (shared with Bedrock)
